instructions.name: startSceneScript
instructions.description: Start a parallel child script with an explicit kind and the same script base. Its entry is relative to the next instruction; register its task handle.

instructions.name: startAnonymousSceneScript
instructions.description: Start a parallel child script as in 00, with kind 128. This is not a stack-based call/return.

instructions.name: finishSceneTask
instructions.description: Remove the current task from the registered handles, clear its owner at context +8, and terminate this script task.

instructions.name: waitForSceneScript
instructions.description: Set the child-script filter at +7 and wait while a matching registered task exists. Kind 255 matches any task; this does not select an actor.

instructions.name: waitForAllSceneScripts
instructions.description: Wait until all registered child-script tasks have finished by using filter 255.

instructions.name: cancelSceneScripts
instructions.description: Release tasks in the 16 registered handle slots and clear the slots. This does not remove map actors.

instructions.name: fadeSceneBrightness
instructions.description: Skip when the global scene-state halfword is 3; otherwise start a brightness task. Its factory uses high(b1)-low(b1), b2, and b3.

instructions.name: restoreSceneBrightness
instructions.description: Start the mode-1 branch of the brightness factory with a null command pointer. Its exact restore/default result depends on the downstream callback.

instructions.name: initializeSceneBlend
instructions.description: Write 00, 03, 10, 00 to display-shadow offsets +4a through +4d, configuring blending, then yield until the next scheduling pass.

instructions.name: clearSceneBlend
instructions.description: Clear the BLDCNT and BLDALPHA display-shadow fields, then yield until the next scheduling pass.

instructions.name: sceneOp0A
instructions.description: Resolve an actor and invoke the same callback on its child objects at +54 and +58 with value. The final visual meaning remains unresolved.

instructions.name: fadeSceneAlpha
instructions.description: Create a two-channel alpha-blending interpolation task. Callback 081269e4 updates both BLDALPHA bytes and notifies the owner when complete.

instructions.name: loadSceneMap
instructions.description: Use the current 40-byte content record's map when b1 is zero, otherwise use b1. Write save byte 7, set global scene state to 10, and wait for state 14.

instructions.name: setSceneRuntimeState12
instructions.description: Set the global scene-state byte to 12 and wait for the outer controller to reach 14.

instructions.name: setBackgroundLayers
instructions.description: Set display-shadow bits 0x0300 when enabled is nonzero, or clear them otherwise; background-layer visibility control.

instructions.name: showDialogue
instructions.description: Create a 180-byte native dialogue event task. The native callback consumes its text selector, speaker, and presentation flags.

instructions.name: setSceneContentWord
instructions.description: Write a halfword at content-state address 020020d0+a4. Its specific mission role is not assigned a general name.

instructions.name: showSceneMessage
instructions.description: Start the 180-byte message/prompt event whose callback is 08125de8. The final text-selection contract remains unresolved.

instructions.name: showScenePrompt
instructions.description: If b1 has its high bit set, use mode 1 and b1-128; otherwise use mode 2 and b1. Start the 08125fa8 prompt/dialogue task, not a generic scene-mode bit write.

instructions.name: startSceneContextEvent
instructions.description: Start the 180-byte context event with callback 08126118 and clear the owner's completion flag. Its final interaction contract remains unresolved.

instructions.name: waitForSceneCompletion
instructions.description: Return asynchronous-completion wait status without starting an action. Unused in retail scripts; it can hang without a completion producer.

instructions.name: waitFrames8
instructions.description: Set the context +4 frame countdown from an unsigned byte and wait. Zero resumes after the next state polling pass.

instructions.name: waitFrames16
instructions.description: Set the context +4 frame countdown from an unsigned halfword and wait, as in 15.

instructions.name: setSceneRuntimeMode
instructions.description: Write the scene-control byte in the global root. Modes 4 and 8 invoke additional transitions; then terminate the current script.

instructions.name: transitionSceneState
instructions.description: Write the transition state at +6. Remap 3 to 1, 6 to 3, and 7 to 5; modes 9/10/11/14 have dedicated workflows. Other paths enter the transition state machine.

instructions.name: adjustScriptOffset
instructions.description: Add a 16-bit displacement to PC; the dispatcher then adds the instruction length of 3. The resulting branch is relative to the next instruction.

instructions.name: setStoryFlag
instructions.description: Set or clear a native bit flag through 080c9574. The actual bitfield covers IDs 0-1535; the handler does not allocate safe custom flags.

instructions.name: writeNativeSaveByte
instructions.description: Write the save byte at RAM 02002030+index through 080c95c0. This is separate from the bit flags used by 1a; unused in retail scripts.

instructions.name: queueScene
instructions.description: Append a halfword scene ID to the queue at 02002194 and increment its count at 0200219c. The handler does not check queue capacity.

instructions.name: setSceneStatePair
instructions.description: Write the same byte to 02002190 and 02002191. These belong to outer scene state and are not general custom variables.

instructions.name: applySceneSelector
instructions.description: Resolve b1 through 08036330, write 02001f69, clear 02003c2b, and apply through 08036584. The selector's final domain remains unresolved.

instructions.name: placeScenePackedActor
instructions.description: Split two packed coordinate pairs and forward them with the other parameters to scene-placement factory 081242a0. Template identity and lifecycle depend on that factory.

instructions.name: placeSceneActor
instructions.description: Forward the low/high coordinate nibbles, facing, and the low flags nibble to actor-configuration helper 08124480. The opening uses a verified placement subset.

instructions.name: sceneOp21
instructions.description: Apply a selector/value pair through 08124560. The final field and mode meanings remain unresolved.

instructions.name: selectSceneTarget
instructions.description: Call 08124648 for selector zero, otherwise 08125624, then enter countdown wait. The existing +4 value may matter; the final selection contract remains unresolved.

instructions.name: clearActorFlag0
instructions.description: Clear bit 0 of the resolved actor object's flags through 08125760 and preserve other bits; yield until the next scheduling pass.

instructions.name: setActorFlag0
instructions.description: Set bit 0 of the resolved actor object's flags through 08125760 and preserve other bits; yield until the next scheduling pass.

instructions.name: turnActorAction
instructions.description: Create a native asynchronous facing action through 08126dfc and callback 08126bfc, notifying the owner on completion. This differs from direct field write 29.

instructions.name: createActionFromHandles
instructions.description: Request that firstHandle face secondHandle through 08126e34 and DetermineSceneFacing at 08124acc. A separate direction-transition task signals completion; the historical expression name is retained.

instructions.name: playActorAction
instructions.description: Create a unit action task through 08126ea4 and callback 08126d34. An action argument is not automatically a graphics-animation resource ID.

instructions.name: refreshActorFacing
instructions.description: Read the resolved actor's unit byte +f8 and reapply kind-1 state through 08124710. The opening uses this to refresh facing.

instructions.name: setActorFacing
instructions.description: Write actor byte +1f directly. It does not independently refresh or wait; the opening pairs it with 28.

instructions.name: restoreSceneUnit
instructions.description: Restore current HP and MP from their maximum values, clear several status ranges, reset actor flags, and refresh through 08124d58. This is not arbitrary HP assignment.

instructions.name: actorPaletteOverride
instructions.description: Start actor palette-override callback 0812682c. The script continues immediately; conditions including 100 have original-palette restoration paths.

instructions.name: sceneOp2C
instructions.description: Start the 72-byte task whose callback is 08126910 without waiting in the main script. Its final presentation semantics remain unresolved.

instructions.name: setSceneUnitState
instructions.description: Apply a unit-state write through 080cd884. When stateIndex is zero, additionally clear current HP at +18 and current MP at +1c.

instructions.name: addActorPosition
instructions.description: Add three 16-bit values to actor fields +08, +0c, and +0a with 16-bit wraparound. This is not a direct grid-tile assignment.

instructions.name: setActorTile
instructions.description: Update unit grid coordinates and actor position. Coordinate 255 preserves the corresponding current world axis shifted right by 5; update unit f6/f7 and f9/fa.

instructions.name: setActorStateMasks
instructions.description: Mode 0 controls actor-flags bit 2. Mode 1 updates bits 0x1000/0x4000 according to value and invokes a refresh helper; their final meanings remain unresolved.

instructions.name: replaceActorAction
instructions.description: Clear actor attachments, multiply the argument by 4 and truncate to u16 for action update, refresh presentation, and set actor-flags bit 0x100.

instructions.name: refreshActorPaletteSlot
instructions.description: Read the unit's native palette/slot value and update actor byte +1e. This does not create a unit.

instructions.name: spawnSceneActor
instructions.description: Instantiate a scene actor from a type, reference unit, and three candidate tiles. Helper 08125444 chooses the first vacant tile and computes facing; this does not prove combat-turn registration.
instructions.luaSyntax: spawnSceneActor(type, reference, x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3)

instructions.name: selectSceneUnit
instructions.description: For selectors 254/255, scan eligible primary units and set flags 0x400. Otherwise select from the 12 encounter slots and write saved selection slot 0, 1, or 2.

instructions.name: bindSavedSceneUnit
instructions.description: Bind a native unit handle from saved selection slot 0/1/2 using a one-based index. An empty selection can underflow; this is not an unchecked general binding API.

instructions.name: beginSceneReward
instructions.description: Set transition state +6 to 7 and +4 to selector, then enter the mission reward/unit-result workflow. This is not an ordinary conditional branch.

instructions.name: setSceneUnitFlag100
instructions.description: Resolve a native unit and set bit 0x100 in its +28 flags halfword when present.

instructions.name: sceneOp38
instructions.description: Pack selector, signed 16-bit value, mode, and amount for 08127c54. The final height/action meaning remains unresolved.

instructions.name: moveActorByDelta
instructions.description: Pack two words containing actor, signed deltas, mode, and argument for 08127b80. Opcode 3a uses the same path after computing deltas from target tiles.

instructions.name: moveActorToTile
instructions.description: Compute target-tile-center deltas through 08124e74; a negative coordinate produces zero delta for that axis. Create the action through 08127b80.

instructions.name: sceneNoop3B
instructions.description: The retail handler only returns 110. This eight-byte instruction is a no-op and is unused by retail programs.
instructions.luaSyntax: sceneNoop3B(b1, b2, b3, b4, b5, b6, b7)

instructions.name: sceneNoop3C
instructions.description: The retail handler only returns 110. This six-byte instruction is a no-op and is unused by retail programs.

instructions.name: moveActorByDeltaMode
instructions.description: Use signed deltas directly with the movement factories shared by 3e. Dispatch 1 calls 08127c10; other values call 08127bc4.
instructions.luaSyntax: moveActorByDeltaMode(actor, dx, dy, mode, dispatch, argument)

instructions.name: moveActorOnGrid
instructions.description: Compute target-tile deltas, write mode to payload byte 1 and argument to payload +6, then select 08127c10/08127bc4. Retail assembly confirms +6; one partial C recovery incorrectly writes +2.
instructions.luaSyntax: moveActorOnGrid(actor, x, y, facing, mode, speed)

instructions.name: applySceneLine
instructions.description: For distinct packed coordinates sharing an x or y coordinate, unpack both nibble pairs and invoke straight-line helper 08124974.

instructions.name: applyActorSceneLine
instructions.description: Read the start tile from the actor's unit f6/f7 and invoke 08124974 only when the target shares its row or column.

instructions.name: runActorPath
instructions.description: Use low(b2) as a path slot and bits 4-6 as the repetition parameter for 08127af8. Bit 7 does not enter that parameter.

instructions.name: runActorPathRange
instructions.description: Create a path request through 08127af8 with repetitions high-low+1, narrowed to a byte. A reversed range is not checked for safety.

instructions.name: mergeScenePaths
instructions.description: Merge two cached paths by removing the last point of the first and appending the whole second. Source slots are the low/high nibbles; the destination cache holds only 32 points.

instructions.name: runActorCoordinatePath
instructions.description: Create coordinate-path task 08127b40 with delay from the low nibble and tail from the high nibble of b4. Byte b3 is unused.

instructions.name: loadScenePath
instructions.description: Load a coordinate path from the relative directory at A19D18 into a cache slot, adding terrain height and clearing entry flags. This does not append new path assets.

instructions.name: moveCameraToActor
instructions.description: Project an actor's tile position and terrain height into a camera target. Modes 1/2/0 use interpolation; mode 0 indexes a speed table and mode 3 starts 08128898.

instructions.name: moveSceneCamera
instructions.description: Move the camera to signed coordinates. Mode 1 with amount zero sets immediately; modes 1/2 compute countdowns, mode 0 indexes a table, and mode 3 creates a task.

instructions.name: prepareMapView
instructions.description: Execute scene selector 08123e00. If native save byte 13 equals 1, return wait status 119. This reads a byte, not story bit flag 13.

instructions.name: restoreSceneContext
instructions.description: For nonzero restore, release/restore scene resources and compact the roster when pending bit 8 is set. Zero ensures a restore actor exists; this is not a generic scene end.

instructions.name: applyCurrentSceneSelection
instructions.description: Apply the current content index to its context through 08096e18; related to mission/deployment selection.

instructions.name: selectScenePresentation
instructions.description: Select an audio/presentation preset. Value 255 reads current content-record byte +26, with a special global-state path using save byte 20. Apply the selector and yield.

instructions.name: playSceneAudioDefinition
instructions.description: Apply native audio-definition service 08141570. Modes 255/2/4 prepare selected volume bytes at 100 and map to service channels 1/2; clear the countdown and wait one scheduling pass.

instructions.name: fadeSceneAudio
instructions.description: Replicate level into selected byte channels and start volume interpolation through 0812800c. Downstream calls reach floating-point volume setters; mask bit 3 is not a verified fourth audio track.

instructions.name: loadEncounterUnits
instructions.description: Populate units from explicit unit/placement banks when available, otherwise from current content. Native save byte 13 equal to 1 selects wait state 11a.

instructions.name: updateSceneActorTransition
instructions.description: For nonzero update, refresh selected unit actions; otherwise filter actors for transition. This does not register a newly spawned combatant.

instructions.name: sceneOp50
instructions.description: Start a context action through 081286dc. Its exact control/input-feedback semantics remain unresolved.

instructions.name: resetSceneActionContext
instructions.description: Call 0809a260(context, 0) and then 080a9548. This is not established as a generic mission-completion instruction.

instructions.name: clearSceneStoryUnits
instructions.description: Clear story-unit state, commit unit-property and occupancy flags, and refresh values for the 24 primary units.

instructions.name: selectSceneEncounter
instructions.description: Search the 12-byte records at 563a70 in descending order for identifier, write selected record 3c2a, and select its content. Identifier is not a direct unit-bank address.

instructions.name: applySceneSystemValue
instructions.description: Apply value through 080bd11c and write native save byte 53. The final system-property domain remains unresolved.

instructions.name: sceneOp55
instructions.description: Pass four bytes to graphics/map helper 0801ddb4. Its final visual effect remains unresolved.

instructions.name: sceneOp56
instructions.description: Call 0801de20 with constant 3. The final effect remains unresolved.

instructions.name: initializeSceneTaskContext
instructions.description: Start task-context initialization through 080d376c and wait for 080d37f8.

instructions.name: clearSceneTaskContext
instructions.description: Start task-state clearing through 080d37ac and wait for 080d37c4.

instructions.name: selectCurrentSceneEntity
instructions.description: Resolve an actor and store it in the current-entity global slot. This does not create a unit binding.

instructions.name: selectSceneTaskIndex
instructions.description: Pass b1-1, narrowed to u16, to 08124fd0. Input zero becomes 65535; this is not a safe unchecked general index.

instructions.name: waitForSceneTask
instructions.description: If 080d3878 reports completion, release and clear the task context. Otherwise enter polling/cleanup wait state 118.

instructions.name: sceneOp5C
instructions.description: Queue dedicated action B0 with a halfword through 0812b7d0. Its final mission/UI contract remains unresolved.

instructions.name: setSceneContentBytes
instructions.description: Write content-state bytes 020020d0+a6/a7. These are not custom variables.

instructions.name: sceneOp5E
instructions.description: Queue dedicated action 44 through 0812bd2c. Its final UI workflow remains unresolved.

instructions.name: sceneOp5F
instructions.description: Queue dedicated action 44 with a byte through 0812bce4. Its final UI workflow remains unresolved.

instructions.name: sceneOp60
instructions.description: Queue dedicated action 08 through 0812bd0c. This is not a general key-reading instruction.

instructions.name: consumeSceneSaveFlag
instructions.description: When native save byte 13 is 1, clear it, set a 16-frame countdown and content flag 40, then wait and invoke 08004c40. Otherwise continue immediately.

instructions.name: sceneOp62
instructions.description: Create dedicated action 108 through 0812c4e4. A nonzero wait byte waits for completion; zero lets the script continue. The remaining payload contract is unresolved.
instructions.luaSyntax: sceneOp62(payload, b2, b3, b4, b5, b6, b7, wait)

instructions.name: resetSceneView
instructions.description: Reset scene-view state through 08125938, then wait according to the current +4 countdown. The exact visual reset scope remains unresolved.

instructions.name: branchIfUnitUsable
instructions.description: Branch when the selected unit exists and predicates 080c8260 and 080c8240 both return zero.

instructions.name: branchIfStoryFlag
instructions.description: Branch when the indexed native story bit flag is nonzero. High-level when uses this instruction.

instructions.name: addOffsetWhenTargetFlagSet
instructions.description: Branch when a unit exists and the requested bit of its +28 flags halfword is set. The safe bit range is 0-15.

instructions.name: branchIfSceneCounterAbove
instructions.description: Branch when RAM byte 020021b4 is strictly greater than threshold, not less than threshold.

instructions.name: branchIfSceneSelector
instructions.description: Resolve the current saved selector through 08036350. Nonzero b1 requires equality; b1 zero accepts resolved slots 1-6.

instructions.name: branchIfDefinitionFlag1
instructions.description: Branch when bit 0 is set in the current 563a70 definition record's flags at +8.

instructions.name: branchIfDefinitionFlag2Clear
instructions.description: Branch when bit 1 is clear in the current definition record's flags; its polarity differs from 69.

instructions.name: sceneNoop6B
instructions.description: Return 110 with no side effects. This no-op is unused in retail programs.

instructions.name: branchIfUnitAvailable
instructions.description: Branch when a unit exists and exclusion predicates 080c8348, 080cd92c, 080cd95c, 080cd9a4, and 080cd9bc all return zero.

instructions.name: branchIfContentByteClear
instructions.description: Branch when byte +22 of the current 40-byte content record is zero.

instructions.name: branchIfNativeSaveFlag
instructions.description: Branch when native save byte 13 equals exactly 1, not when story bit flag 13 is set.

instructions.name: branchIfHpAbove
instructions.description: For an active unit passing two exclusion checks, branch when current HP exceeds threshold. Thresholds 0-9 are absolute; larger values compare against floor(maxHP*threshold/100), strictly greater.

instructions.name: branchIfNoEligibleUnit
instructions.description: Scan current scene units, excluding specified states and property-1 values 94/10/9/4/12. Branch only when no eligible unit remains; this is not simply all enemy HP equal to zero.

instructions.name: branchOnFirstChoice
instructions.description: Read native menu result SaveByte19. Branch for low byte zero; the second choice and B cancellation (255) continue sequentially. Native menu branching already exists.
